purpose: Qualify source-verified isolated-fragment supervision from existing cached training latents without teacher generation.
inputs: All64cases were selected by sequence-only hash before any structural outcomes. Exact AFDB sequence, complete N/CA/C/O atoms, unique contiguous residue map, and cachedCA agreement are mandatory. Verify cached latent andCA array hashes. Align the actual source backbone to cachedCAs with a proper FP64rotation before full encoding parity checks. Keep the cached target latent unchanged.
conditioning: Crop each source backbone before FP64canonicalization and encoding. Only the crop's coordinates,8normalized latent channels,and cropped amino-acid sequence may form a condition. No full sequence or scaffold coordinates enter conditioning. The original512training inputs remain untouched.
controls: Four historical isolated codes must reproduce within1e-5; every new center30percent crop has a rigid-pose latent/coordinate control<=1e-4. One full-chain decode per length bucket repeats withinCA RMSD.01AandlDDT.999. All controls must pass. Require all64source-frame and full-encoding parity checks; at least90percent of source+decoded endpoints coarse-valid with decodedCA RMSD<=1A, and90percent of576fragment roundtrips satisfy both properRMSD/dRMS<=.5A. Retain all failed cases and no posthoc replacement.
scope: Training-data feasibility only; no conditional-model predictions or designability claim. Passing this pilot permits full source/data qualification, which must precede a separate matched training experiment. No evaluation labels are used.
